arithmetic: Python standard-library integers and fractions.Fraction; no floating point
checked_identities: exact R_n polynomial division and separate integer convolution identity

definitions.W_n: sum_{k=1}^n a_k sum_{r=0}^{k-1} mu_r X^(k-1-r), where P_n=sum a_k X^k
definitions.mu_r: 0 for odd r, 2/(r+1) for even r; integral of X^r on [-1,1]
definitions.source_indexing: polyPair k=(P_k,P_(k+1)); root order n uses (polyPair (n-1)).2

encoding: Ascending power numerators divided by one positive common denominator; integer values are decimal strings; empty numerators encode zero.
